editorial:
Imagine working at a boring office where your only joy is obsessing over your favorite superhero show. That is exactly where you find Tsuyoshi and Naoto. They spend their entire workday dodging their boss and watching Forticus on their phones, while their coworker Koharu just rolls her eyes at them. The vibe is super light and funny until a wild interview trip turns into a total nightmare. Suddenly, the fantasy world they love crashes into their real lives, and the actual Forticus shows up. It is a wild ride that feels like a love letter to every fan who ever wished their favorite show was real.

What really pops here is the action. Since Koichi Sakamoto is directing, the fight scenes are smooth, flashy, and high-energy. The chemistry between the three leads makes the jokes land well, though some of the middle parts drag a bit. You will love how it blends office comedy with huge monster battles.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a huge twist where you learn the show was actually a signal to find new heroes. Tsuyoshi and Naoto discover that their obsession gave them the right spirit to actually wield the Forticus powers. They team up for one final battle to stop the real-world monsters. After saving the city, they don't go back to their boring jobs, but instead become the new guardians of Earth in secret.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves tokusatsu, superheroes, and workplace comedies.
